infobox.usage: Unlocks a door in spawn chamber 2 in The Labyrinth.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Key 02 (Key 02) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: This key probably opens some kind of an old lock. The number engraving has been practically scratched off. Could be useful for surviving the Labyrinth.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text: Different locations in spawn chamber 2 inside The Labyrinth.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text: The 2nd floor where the Valve handwheel can be found.
